blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nearly 5,000 victims of the 2017 Marawi siege are still awaiting compensation, prompting Sen. Erwin Tulfo on Friday to press the government to settle all remaining claims by 2028. During the Senate’s deliberations on the proposed P1.247-billion budget of the Marawi Compensation Board for 2027, Tulfo questioned the slow pace of the compensation process, noting that residents have waited nearly a decade for the promised rehabilitation of their homes and communities. “Nine years na po. (It’s been nine years) Does it take nine years to build a house?” Tulfo asked, seeking an update on how many families remain […]...
